verdict.rationale: Brave documents dedicated vertical services for news ([28]), images with filtering and SafeSearch ([29]), video ([41]) and places/POIs ([42], [50]). The llms.txt probe and the official MCP server also expose web, image, video and news search as separate capabilities ([probe-1], [15]). Finance-style data comes through the Rich Search API's stocks vertical ([25], [49]) rather than a dedicated finance endpoint. missing for 10: endpoint-level parameter and filter details for the news and image verticals, a dedicated finance endpoint beyond rich-result stocks, independent hands-on corroboration.
